digest.component_or_area: config schema and duplicate-ticket suggestion feature
propositions: verify.overlap_enabled is poorly named (describes internal mechanism rather than user-visible output) and undocumented in docs/config.md, causing operator confusion about what the setting produces and its cost implications.

The config key must be renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets to reflect its advisory nature and output (duplicate-ticket link suggestions), requiring permanent TOML and env-var aliases for live configs to avoid breakage.

Two permanent registry rows and one _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES entry must implement back-compat: cfg:verify.overlap_enabled and env:REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED both map forward with permanent-alias messaging.

docs/config.md must add an inventory entry documenting the setting's output (up to three advisory link suggestions), its three-stage process (digest extraction, BM25F retrieval, LLM judge), that it never blocks claim or close, and that its cost scales with tracker size.

The canonical field on VerifyConfig and its _SECTIONS coercer must switch to suggest_duplicate_tickets, and all in-source readers (enrich_drain.py, plan_review/__init__.py) plus this repo's rebar.toml must use the new name.
